text:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: hosted-api us-east - request queue growing rapidly. p95 -> 5.6s, p99 -> 18s, 5xx rate ↑. Provisioner is returning rate limit/quota errors; new GPU nodes not coming up. Paging oncall.

maya: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking provisioner state.

kenji: seeing repeated errors in provisioner logs:
```
2026-02-18T23:02:11Z ERROR provisioner: create_instance failed: quotaExceeded (rateLimitExceeded)
2026-02-18T23:02:12Z WARN scale-controller: backoff remaining=42s attempts=3
```
looks like cloud-side rate limits + scale-controller backoff.

rohan: impact summary from metrics: host-api-queue length 14k -> 56k in 10m, throttle events increasing. several _sync_ customers getting 504s. ~12 tenants >30% error rate.

maya: plan: 1) enable per-route fallback to cpu-quant model for high-latency routes, 2) reduce max_tokens for fallbacks, 3) pause non-critical background model loads. executing step 1 now.

liz: how do we flip fallback? small snippet:
```
PATCH /routes/chat
{ "fallback_model": "gpt-3.5-quant", "weight": 1.0 }
```
I can push the override if you want.

maya: please push, liz. also enable temporary enqueue-throttle to preserve headroom: set queue.max_inflight=800 -> 2500? actually we want to LOWER per-tenant concurrency to 50.

kenji: tried to bump provisioner parallelism: `provisioner set --max-concurrent=8` -> still seeing 429s from provider. Cloud quota increase request already in flight but won't help immediate.

ops-bot: deployed route override for /chat -> gpt-3.5-quant, reduced default max_tokens to 256, adjusted tenant concurrency to 50 for high-traffic customers. Monitoring logs.

maya: metrics: p95 dropped from 5.6s -> 1.8s in 3m, p99 down to 6.5s, 5xx rate falling. queue length trending down slowly.

rohan: customer impact note: short-lived user-facing errors for some sync APIs, async/embeddings mostly unaffected. impacted customers list exported to ops ticket (#INC-4821).

maya: handing off to kenji for follow-up and remediation (quota escalations + autoscaler tuning). I'll stay nearby for postmortem. kenji, you're oncall for next hour.

kenji: taking pager. will coordinate with cloud support and runbook. adding runbook note about provider rate-limits and fallback config change. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVE CHECKPOINT: mitigations applied, monitoring stable, continue 1:1 follow-up. :white_check_mark:
